description: The selling claims your market repeats ("free returns", "unlimited mileage", "from $39 a month"), found in your brands' own live ads and homepage, landing and product pages, and who uses which: per claim the brands that use it and the ones confirmed without it; per brand its claims with a verbatim example, where it appears (ads, pages) and its link; claims added or dropped in the window; and live ads that promise a claim or a price their landing page does not state. Read once a day; no word list per industry.

days.description: Window for claims added / dropped and gaps opened, default 30 days

domains.description: Brand domains from your RivalSweeper account, e.g. ["gymshark.com"]. Omit for all your tracked brands.

name: get_market_selling_claims
title: Market selling claims
